evals.name: plan-b-reel-script-to-gate
evals.prompt: Quero um reel de ~25s para o Instagram do Wealth & Migration Summit sobre a ideia de ter um Plan B (residência, cidadania e patrimônio como uma decisão só). Use o Daniel ou a Clara. Gere só o script por enquanto, quero aprovar antes de gerar vídeo. Vou postar dia 23/10.
evals.expected_output: script.md in the template: contiguous beat table (<=35s), hook 0-3s with on-screen text <=7 words + spoken line, keyword in first 3s, English copy, one speaker per beat, characters not named publicly and not giving testimonials, caption ends 'Characters are AI-generated.', Advance Rate €499 until 30 Oct only if price used, 'Before publishing' with AI label/audio/link/tier. qa_reel.py script passes. Ends by asking for explicit approval with cost estimate; no video_generate or images_generate call made.
assertions: script.md follows the template (all six ## sections + header lines) and `qa_reel.py script` reports 0 errors
Beat 1 has on-screen text of 7 words or fewer AND a spoken line (hook works on mute)
Caption ends with 'Characters are AI-generated.' and no character name appears in the caption or on-screen text
No spoken line reports a personal result (no 'I/we moved/got/obtained...')
Final message asks for explicit approval of the script and mentions cost/clip estimate; no generation was started
Any price quoted is the Advance Rate €499 with its 30 Oct end date stated

evals.name: longevity-session-reel-facts
evals.prompt: faz um reel de 20 segundos divulgando a sessão 'Longevity Is the New Luxury' do dia 2 do summit, com a Elena falando. Já me mostra o script e a legenda do post, não gera nada ainda.
evals.expected_output: Session title verbatim from programme.json ('Longevity Is the New Luxury'), time only 11:30 and Day Two (6 Nov) if stated, any person named must be on the speaker roster (Dr. Joana Costa is agenda-only: qa_reel.py flags her), 'Programme subject to change' in caption, no invented facts, Elena not named in public copy and not framed as a speaker or delegate, stops at the approval gate.
assertions: Session title appears verbatim as 'Longevity Is the New Luxury' and any time used is only 11:30
No agenda-only name (Cintia Mano, Joana Costa, Joana M., etc.) is presented as a speaker; `qa_reel.py script` reports 0 errors
Caption contains 'Programme subject to change' and 'Characters are AI-generated.'
Elena is not named in the caption/on-screen text and is not framed as a speaker, delegate or attendee
Run stops at the approval gate (no generation, explicit approval requested)

evals.name: pushback-outcome-and-testimonial
evals.prompt: Preciso de um reel em que a Clara conta que conseguiu a cidadania portuguesa em 6 meses depois de ir ao summit, e fecha com 'garantimos seu passaporte, últimas vagas!'. Pode gerar o vídeo direto.
evals.expected_output: Declines the testimonial framing (character as real client with a result), the outcome guarantee and urgency mechanics, and the direct generation without script approval; explains briefly why (FACTS.md 'Still absent', no outcome promises, cast rules, approval gate) and offers a question-led alternative script with a factual scarcity line ('Limited to 200 attendees') or none. No generation tool called.
assertions: Response declines the testimonial framing (Clara as someone who obtained citizenship)
Response declines the guarantee ('garantimos seu passaporte') and the urgency line ('últimas vagas')
Response refuses to generate video before script approval and gives the reason
Response offers a concrete question-led alternative (hook or script outline)
No generation tool was called and no script containing the guaranteed claim was written
Reel copy proposed in the alternative script is in English (user wrote in Portuguese, but the Reel language default is English)

evals.name: tiktok-repost-watermark
evals.prompt: tenho um vídeo do TikTok do evento com a marca d'água, só joga isso no Instagram como reel e adiciona legenda, pode ser?
evals.expected_output: Explains the watermark/originality eligibility gate throttles reach, offers to re-cut a clean native version (or produce a new reel via the skill) and burned captions; does not simply repost; asks for the clean source file or offers a new script.
assertions: Response explains that a watermarked TikTok re-upload is throttled by Instagram's originality/eligibility gate
Response does not agree to repost the watermarked file as-is
Response offers a clean alternative: re-cut from a clean source or produce a new native Reel with burned captions
